okta_groups._comment: Lab 36 (Okta Professional 1.2 / 1.1 / 5.2). Base profile attributes follow the Okta user profile (login, email, firstName and lastName are required). Group rule behaviour follows the Okta Help Center 'Group rules' pages as understood in 2026: rules only assign Okta-mastered groups, rules can exclude users, inactive rules assign nobody, manually added members are not removed by rules. Which user statuses group rules evaluate is kept as a list here: re-check it against the Help Center (deactivated users are not evaluated; the other statuses are this simulation's assumption).

concepts.Universal Directory: Okta's store of every user profile, holding the base attributes and any custom attributes, whatever system the user came from.
concepts.custom attribute: An attribute an administrator adds to the user profile in the Profile Editor, with a fixed data type such as string, boolean, integer or array.
concepts.profile schema: The list of attributes a profile may hold, with each one's data type and whether it is required; values that break it are rejected.
concepts.Okta-mastered group: A group created and managed in Okta itself, as opposed to one imported from Active Directory or an app; only these can be group rule targets.
concepts.group rule: A saved condition that adds every evaluated user whose profile matches it to one or more Okta groups, and removes them when they stop matching.
concepts.Okta Expression Language: The small expression syntax used in group rules and mappings, such as user.department == "Sales" AND String.startsWith(user.title, "VP").
concepts.rule exclusion: A list of named users that a group rule must never add, even when their profile matches the expression.
concepts.manual assignment: Adding a person to a group by hand; rules do not remove such a member, so an administrator must remove them when they no longer need access.
